metadata.content:
*You suddenly strike an enemy, then grab them in a psionically enhanced grip.*

| **[Melee](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/melee), Psionic, [Strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike), Weapon** |  **Free triggered** |
|------------------------------------|--------------------:|
| **📏 [Melee](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/melee) 1**                     | **🎯 One creature** |

**Trigger:** The target moves or uses a main action.

**[Power Roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll) + [Agility](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/agility):**

- **≤11:** 7 + A damage; I < WEAK, [restrained](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/restrained) (save ends)
- **12-16:** 10 + A damage; I < AVERAGE, [restrained](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/restrained) (save ends)
- **17+:** 13 + A damage; I < STRONG, [restrained](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/restrained) (save ends)

**Effect:** This [strike](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/strike) resolves before the triggering movement or main action.
